text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Found you~♪ Jeez, Sky-chan, everyone was 
looking for you, you know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh, I wonder what that's about? I 
shouldn't have any business with them, 
though."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, playing dumb? It's your birthday, so 
everyone just wants to celebrate with you, 
Sky-chan.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, I see~. I mean, not that I'm not 
happy about it, though!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You know, isn't Sei-chan the reserved 
type? Like, she wouldn't want to stand out 
too much, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep. You get shy when you're 
surrounded by everyone, right? ...Hehe, I 
totally get it~.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Even at the club I used to go to, everyone 
made a huge fuss whenever it was someone's 
birthday. Whenever it was my turn, I'd get 
kind of bashful—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Still, I think everyone just wants to tell 
you: "Thank you for being with us, we love 
you so much."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I feel the exact same way♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, coming right down the middle here, 
huh...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright, I give up! I'll 
definitely drop by later, okay?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...I feel like that just gave me immunity!
